reason: My knees and shoulders take a beating at the gym and I've been wanting a collagen I can actually trust is halal, so for £4.95 I'll try the trial pack in my chai. I'm not committing to £18 a month until I've checked the certificate myself and seen whether it does anything.
objection: The ad says 'a named UK halal certification body' but doesn't tell me which one up front. With bovine collagen the slaughter method is the whole question, so I need to know if it's a certifier I trust, like HMC, before I put it in my body every day.
would_change_my_mind: If the certifier turned out to be one I don't trust or the certificate didn't cover the collagen source itself, I'd stop after the trial. If a creator I follow showed real results after a month, I'd go on the subscription.
